question: Will Ukraine's Starlink be fully restored this week, yes or no?

lines.text: Donald Trump says Elon Musk has restored Ukraine's Starlink access.
But Kyiv says its military link is still capped at one hundred and sixty one kilometres an hour.
Ukraine uses it for battlefield communications and drone missions, Reuters says.
The Wall Street Journal says Trump called Musk and asked him to lift the limits.
Asked if he made that call, Trump said he did not want to comment.
Then he added: the bottom line, he put it back.

scene.quote: The bottom line, he put it back.

lines.text: The Journal says it worked more normally after the call, citing officials.
But a Ukrainian official told the Kyiv Independent the reports were false.
President Zelensky also says speeds have not been restored.
He says he asked Marco Rubio if it could work at up to four hundred kilometres an hour.
The official says the cap limits mid-range strikes and fast drone interceptions.
Zelensky says Rubio promised him an answer within forty eight hours.
Rubio says Starlink access is for SpaceX and Musk, not the White House.
Will Ukraine's Starlink be fully restored this week, yes or no?
